I am a third year PhD student in the Statistics Department at the University of Michigan. 
I am currently working on transfer learning and score-explained heterogenous treatment effect models.

My thesis advisors are [Moulinath Banerjee](https://dept.stat.lsa.umich.edu/~moulib/main-info.html) and [Yuekai Sun](https://yuekai.github.io/).
